title: Ankai N12 Bus Enhances China-Kazakhstan Passenger Transport
summary: A batch of Ankai N12 luxury highway buses was delivered to Horgos to operate on the international passenger line from Horgos to Almaty, upgrading cross-border passenger services.
content:
Horgos, located at the westernmost tip of Ili, Xinjiang, has been a Silk Road post and a trading port since ancient times, as well as a core gateway for China's westward opening-up. Here, China's national gate and the plains of Kazakhstan face each other just a stone's throw away, forming a unique cross-border landmark.

On May 29, 2026, a batch of Ankai N12 luxury highway buses was officially delivered to Horgos Huaxin Transportation Service Co., Ltd. This batch of vehicles will be fully put into operation on the international passenger dedicated line from Horgos to Almaty, helping the quality of China-Kazakhstan cross-border passenger services leap forward across the board and empowering the development of cross-border transportation between the two countries.

## A Key Livelihood and Economic-Trade Corridor

The Horgos-Almaty international road passenger regular line is an important cross-border transport link connecting China and Kazakhstan, as well as a key livelihood and economic-trade corridor for advancing the high-quality development of the Belt and Road initiative and deepening bilateral exchanges between the two countries.

With the implementation of the mutual visa exemption policy between China and Kazakhstan, cross-border family visits, tourism and business passenger flows have experienced explosive growth. Facing the continuously climbing transportation pressure, traditional capacity has found it difficult to meet the demand for high-quality travel. Relying on the unique geographical advantages of Horgos Port, Huaxin Transportation has deeply cultivated the cross-border passenger transport sector for many years and actively responded to the national call to upgrade routes and services with high-end transport forces.
